md: Much of my absolutist outlook in life has been generalised outward from an embarrrassingly (in the sense that it's inappropriate to generalise outward from) specific psychological deficiency. I possess no defense against the arrival of (an episodic instance of) a self-destructive tendency, other than allowing it to ravage my mind and body until the ensuing executive dysfunction prevents me from engaging with it anymore. Consequently, the only way in which I can be functional in life is to prevent all such arrivals.
